enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The Crewlet stack in the AWS account and the engine's certificate authority the agents' IAM roles are made with. Required when enabled.

certificate_authority.description: The engine's certificate authority: its P-256 private key, then its certificate, both PEM. Minted by the connect form and never shown; the stack's trust anchor holds only the certificate. It can sign in as the provisioner, which can create agent roles and attach the Crewlet levels.

connection.description: The stack's CrewletConnection output: five ARNs joined by commas, as the last line of the CloudShell block prints them. Until it is set, no agent's role can be made.

home_region.description: Region code the Crewlet stack, its trust anchor and its profiles live in, such as eu-west-1.

iam_read.description: Let every agent that is on read IAM users, groups, roles and policies. Off by default, since it shows the people in the account.

regions.description: Region codes agents may work in; the stack refuses them every other Region. Empty is the home Region and us-east-1. Changing the list means updating the stack.

slug.description: Short name every Crewlet name in the account carries, as crewlet-<slug>: up to 20 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Set when the certificate authority is minted, and fixed once the stack exists.

retention_days.description: How long the record of what each agent was told about its access, and of every SSH certificate and command, is kept (default 400, 90..3650). Each agent's newest record stays while the agent exists.

deep_work.description: Deep work: Ask Crewlet hands a large task to a harness running its own tools in a sandbox, reaching Crewlet only through the person's own Ask Crewlet tools. Absent: quick mode only.

enabled.description: Run Ask Crewlet for this company. Absent or false: off.

llm.description: providers.llm keys Ask Crewlet runs on, a fallback chain. Required when enabled. Each must be an entry whose harness's local tools are denied and, through overrides.web_tools, its web tools.

max_steps.description: Most tool steps one Ask Crewlet turn may take, 1..40. Absent: 30.

proposal_ttl_seconds.description: How long a proposed change waits for approval, 60..3600 seconds. Absent: 900.

retention_days.description: How long a person's Ask Crewlet conversations are kept, 1..365 days. Absent: 30.

token_budget.description: Each person's Ask Crewlet token ceilings per calendar window on the company clock: day, week and month, each optional. Absent = no per-person ceiling; the company's own budget still applies. A ceiling at or above the company's on a window that holds it is warned of, since the company's is reached first.

turn_timeout_seconds.description: Longest one Ask Crewlet turn may run, 30..1200 seconds. Absent: 900.

llm.description: providers.llm key deep work runs on: an entry driving claude-code. Required.

max_steps.description: Most agentic rounds and Crewlet tool calls one deep-work run may make, 10..400. Absent: 150.

max_tokens.description: Most tokens one deep-work run may spend before it is stopped, 10000..20000000. Absent: 3000000. The person's and the company's budgets still apply.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest one deep-work run may take, 60..1200 seconds. Absent: 1200.

api_key.description: Unscoped organization API key. A scoped key is refused by the account-management API.

deployment.description: Which Atlassian this company runs: cloud or data_center. The form opens on cloud; a value written here also decides a Jira or Confluence url whose host is not Atlassian's own.

backend.description: Which chat surface: chatlet, vendor, or none. Empty derives from integrations.mattermost, integrations.slack and the seats' Slack apps.

default_channel_private.description: Create channels private when the caller names no visibility. Default false: a company's rooms are readable by its seats.

message_retention_days.description: How long a message lives (default 365, 30..3650). 0 keeps messages for ever.

typing_status.description: When to show the working indicator (default always).

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The Cloudflare account and the provisioner token the engine mints each agent's token with. Required when enabled.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID (32 hexadecimal characters) the agents' tokens are created in.

api_token.description: Account API token with Account API Tokens Write, Account Settings Read, Zone Read and every permission an agent level grants.

zones.description: Zone names the agents' tokens are scoped to. Empty means every zone in the account.

backend.description: Which git host the company runs: gitlet, the engine's own, which hosts its repositories on the engine's own state log, every data node committing their pushes; or none. Empty is none. A node that has run no company yet starts Gitlet at the activation that hands it a company on it; on every other node, whatever backends its first company named, a move between the two takes effect at the node's restart, which the node says (native_backend_needs_restart).

deleted_retention_days.description: How long a repository removed from code.repos stays restorable by declaring it again under its name, before it is purged and its name is free: 1..365 days; unset (or 0) is 7.

identity_domain.description: The domain a commit the engine builds through a tool spells its addresses in: its committer's, engine@<domain>, and its author's, <handle>@<domain>, for a seat whose role states no email address. A lowercase DNS name of at most 189 bytes, so every such address is at most 254; unset is seats.invalid, a name nobody can own.

merge_by_floor.description: The least a merge into any protected branch needs, whatever its rules say: writers (unset) — anybody who may write to the repository — maintainers, or persons, a person and never a seat. A merge is held to the stricter of this and the merge_by of every rule matching its branch; a rule with no merge gate reads as writers.

remote_credentials.description: The variables a repository's mirror or import may name for its credential, by the variable's name, each with the hosts its value may be sent to: a mirror's or an import's credential — in code.repos, or one a person asks for — is refused unless it is the ${NAME} of a variable declared here for its URL's host, and Gitlet dials no other. At most 64. The value is the secret store's or the environment's, as ever: this table holds names and hosts, never a token.

repos.description: The company's repositories, at most 10000. Each activation creates the ones declared and settles their settings; removing one deletes it, restorable for deleted_retention_days by declaring it again.

allow_run_in.description: The cells a repository's checks file may name in a check's run_in, each once: container or e2b. Unset is the one run_in resolves to; set, it holds that one.

env.description: The secrets a check may be given: a check is given exactly the entries its checks file names in its env. Each key a variable name — a letter or an underscore, then letters, digits and underscores, at most 128 bytes — and none the engine sets in a box itself. ${VAR} supported, resolved when a check's box is made.

max_timeout_seconds.description: How long the company lets a check run, whatever its checks file's timeout_seconds: 60..21600 seconds; unset is 3000 — an e2b box on the smallest plan's one-hour session, with ten minutes of it for the box's setup.

run_in.description: The cell a check whose checks file names none runs in: container — a container on a Gitlet node — or e2b, a remote box. Unset is providers.sandbox.default_run_in where that is one of the two, else no cell. direct is refused: a check runs a change's own code, which direct would run as the engine's own user on the engine host.

box_hours_per_day.description: How many hours of remote (e2b) box time the company spends on checks in a UTC day, each box charged a minute at a time while it runs: 0..100000; 0 starts none. Once the day's hours are spent, a new remote check waits queued until the next UTC midnight; a box already running runs to its own end. Unset is 192 (provisional): one merge queue saturated all day at ten-minute checks.

max_running.description: How many remote (e2b) check boxes the company runs at once, whichever Gitlet node starts them: 0..1024; 0 starts none. A check past it waits queued until a box ends. Unset is 16 (provisional): a merge queue's full round of four candidates with two checks each, doubled for the head checks beside it, inside E2B's 20-sandbox Hobby limit.

glob.description: A glob over the repository's tree, from its root, as a path owner's paths are written: * within one component, ** whole components, at most 128 bytes.

unless.description: The path classes — whitespace_only, comment_only — that let a change through without the person's approval when every path this glob matched is of one. Each once.

credential.description: What Gitlet fetches with: one whole ${VAR} reference to a token — a variable code.remote_credentials declares for this url's host — resolved from the secret store and then the environment when it dials, never a literal. Unset fetches anonymously.

url.description: The repository it is filled from: an https URL with no user, query or fragment, at most 1024 bytes.

batch.description: How many waiting changes one candidate takes: 1..8; unset is 2.

depth.description: How many candidates the queue tests at once: 1..8; unset is 4.

max_blob_bytes.description: The largest file (blob) a push may carry, at most max_push_bytes; unset is 50 MiB. A larger binary belongs in Worklet's files.

max_push_bytes.description: The largest pack one push may send; unset is 1 GiB, the most it may be.

pushes_per_seat_day.description: How many pushes one seat may land in one day on the company's calendar, every repository together: 1..100000; unset is 1000. A runaway bound on what a seat pushing in a loop costs the code log, not a budget; a person's pushes are never counted.

repo_max_bytes.description: The most packed bytes one repository may hold, at least max_push_bytes; unset is 20 GiB. Every Gitlet node serving a repository caches it whole.

credential.description: What Gitlet fetches with: one whole ${VAR} reference to a token — a variable code.remote_credentials declares for this url's host — resolved from the secret store and then the environment when it dials, never a literal. Unset fetches anonymously.

url.description: The repository it follows: an https URL with no user, query or fragment, at most 1024 bytes.

as.description: The seat whose identity the push carries at that host, by its handle: a seat that reads this repository — a person's seat reads every one, an agent's what its grant does — never a bot.

credential.description: What Gitlet pushes with: one whole ${VAR} reference to the as seat's own token at that host — a variable code.remote_credentials declares for this url's host — resolved from the secret store and then the environment when it dials, never a literal.

refs.description: The refs it pushes, at most 64 patterns of refs/heads/<glob> and refs/tags/<glob>, each once; unset is the default branch and refs/tags/*. No pattern may reach a seat's own branches under refs/heads/seats/.

url.description: The repository it pushes to: an https URL with no user, query or fragment, at most 1024 bytes.

seat.description: A seat, by its handle. Exactly one of unit and seat.

unit.description: A unit of the chart: its id, or its name where it has none. Exactly one of unit and seat.

paths.description: The paths it owns: 1 to 32 globs over the repository's tree, each relative to its root, at most 128 bytes. A component of * matches one component and * within one any run of characters but /; ** matches whole components (zero or more, one or more as the last), so docs/** is everything inside docs and **/*.go every Go file; a glob holding a * has at most eight components, and a glob with no * matches only that path. ?, [, \ and a leading ! are refused: * is the one metacharacter. Each glob once.

seat.description: A seat, by its handle. Exactly one of unit and seat.

unit.description: A unit of the chart: its id, or its name where it has none — its effective lead is whom a review is asked of. Exactly one of unit and seat.

agents_edit_checks.description: Let a seat's approval stand for a change to .crewlet/** — where a repository's checks are defined — which, on a rule requiring checks, otherwise waits for a person's.

allow_delete.description: Let a push delete a matching ref.

allow_force.description: Let a push move a matching branch to a commit that does not descend from it. Not on a tag rule: a tag never moves.

approvals.description: How many counted approvals a merge waits for: none (unset) or one.

approvals_unless.description: The path classes that exempt a change from those approvals: a change whose every touched path is of a class listed — whitespace_only, comment_only — waits for none. Each once.

branch.description: A branch name or glob: * matches one path component, ** any number, and a name with no * matches only itself. Exactly one of branch and tag.

checks.description: At most 32 checks a merge waits for, by name: a lowercase letter or digit, then up to 63 more of them, '.', '_' and '-'. Each once.

delete_source.description: Whether a merge deletes its change's source branch in the record that merges it: seats (unset), a branch in a seat's own namespace, or none.

direct_push.description: Who may push to a matching ref directly: persons (unset), a person and never a seat, whose push is refused; or none, which freezes it — nothing pushes to it.

human_paths.description: At most 32 globs of the repository's paths a change touching which waits for a person's approval, whatever else approved it. Each glob once.

landing.description: How the branch's queue lands a change: each field its default when unset.

merge_by.description: Who may merge into a matching branch: writers (unset) — anybody who may write to the repository — maintainers, or persons, a person and never a seat. The stricter of this and code.merge_by_floor holds. Merge gate fields are refused on a tag rule: no merge reaches a tag.

owners_approve.description: Make the repository's path owners gating: a change waits for one counted approval from somebody eligible for every owned glob it touches.

tag.description: A tag name or glob, as for branch. Exactly one of branch and tag.

hosts.description: The hosts this variable's value may be sent to, each a host name or an IP address with an optional :port (github.com, gitlab.example.com:8443), matched whole against a mirror's or an import's URL, its port included (443 where none is written): at least one, at most 16, each once.

archived.description: Read-only: still fetched and cloned, and takes no push.

default_branch.description: The branch a clone checks out; unset is main.

import.description: Fills it, when it is created, from a repository at another host: it takes no push until its import is done. Read only by its create: a repository that exists already ignores it.

mirror_from.description: Makes it a pull mirror of a repository at another host: it is imported from there first — when it is created, and when an existing repository is given one or moved to another url — then moves only by Gitlet's syncs from it, and takes no push and no change of its own.

mirror_to.description: Makes it a push mirror: Gitlet pushes the refs it names to a repository at another host, as the seat named by as.

name.description: The repository's name: one label of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or a digit, at most 63 — no dot, which only a seat's own scratch repository's name carries. It is the address a repository is cloned by, so renaming one here deletes it and creates another.

path_owners.description: Who owns which of the repository's paths, at most 64 owners and 256 KiB as the code log records them: a change touching an owner's paths asks it for a review. A path owner is asked, never granted: it reads and pushes what the chart lets it, as before.

protect.description: The rules a push to the refs they match is held to, at most 64. A ref no rule matches may be force-pushed or deleted by anybody who may push.

search.description: How code search reads it: indexed (unset) — from an index of its default branch, by a search across the company's repositories as well as one naming it — or grep — with git grep, and only by a search naming it.

visibility.description: Who may read it besides persons: company (unset) — every seat — or unit — the owning unit's members, its leads and the owning seat.

idle_days.description: How many days a seat's scratch repository may go with no push, rename, settings change or restore before it is deleted — restorable for deleted_retention_days, like any deleted repository. A repository a live turn has named is never deleted while the turn lasts. 1..365; unset is 7.

max_per_seat.description: How many scratch repositories one seat may hold, every one it owns short of purged — a deleted one counts until its purge frees its room. 0 lets no seat create one; 0..1000; unset is 50.

agents_manage_others.description: Let an agent publish over, update and reshare artifacts it does not own. Off by default.

seen_by.description: Who sees who has opened an artifact: editors (the default) or nobody.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for Data Center webhooks.

webhook_token.description: Shared token for Confluence Cloud webhooks, carried in the registered URL; minted by crewlet confluence provision.

enabled.description: Keep each executor launch's harness session, continue it in the turn's relaunches and the conversation's next turn, and tell that turn how the conversation's earlier turns ended (default on; off keeps and continues no session, offers no tool to read them, and still records how each turn ended).

max_bytes_per_seat.description: Object-store bytes one seat's captured executor sessions may hold; past it the oldest ended turns' sessions are released (default 64 MiB, 33 MiB..64 GiB).

retention_days.description: Days a seat's executor sessions are kept past their turn's last record, read at every reaper pass (default 30).

enabled.description: Observe counterparties (default on).
Turn the integration on.

handle_tag.description: Monitor tag key naming the seat an alert wakes (default crewlet).

provisioning.description: Inputs for provisioning agent identities at Datadog.

route_to.description: Handle of the seat an alert naming no owner wakes; required when enabled.

webhook_name.description: Name of the webhook the engine keeps at Datadog; monitors name it as @webhook-<name> (default crewlet).

webhook_token.description: Shared token compared against X-Crewlet-Token; required when enabled.

api_key.description: Datadog API key; says which organization.

app_key.description: Datadog application key; says which user acts.

email_domain.description: Domain agent service-account addresses are built under.

budget_fraction.description: Share of the parent's remaining budget one delegate call may spend.

call_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on a whole delegate call, waves included.

max_parallel.description: Workers running at once within one delegate call.

max_tasks_per_call.description: Tasks one delegate call may contain.

max_turns.description: Tool rounds one worker may run.

max_turns_ceiling.description: Highest max_turns a worker template may declare.

min_tokens_per_task.description: Floor on one worker's token share; below it the call is refused (default 500; 0 = no floor).

insights.description: Anonymous weekly records of how the company's agents work, off until an administrator turns them on.

issue_reports.description: Anonymous reports of the engine's own defects, off until an administrator turns them on.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The DigitalOcean team the agents' tokens act in. Required when enabled.

team.description: The DigitalOcean team the agents' tokens act in, by its name as the control panel's team menu shows it. The first agent's token proves it.

api_key.description: Remote sandbox API key; required. ${VAR} supported.

domain.description: Self-hosted sandbox cluster domain; empty = vendor cloud.

template.description: Box template. This is where vCPU/RAM/disk are set: at template build time.

base_url.description: Endpoint for an openai-compatible embedding service.

dimensions.description: Vector width; 0 takes the named model's own width. 64..4096 to override, and it must match what the model produces.

max_batch_inputs.description: Most inputs one request may carry; 0 takes the named model's documented limit. Required where none is documented; may only lower a documented one.

max_batch_tokens.description: Most tokens one request may carry, summed over its inputs; 0 takes the named model's documented limit. Required where none is documented; may only lower a documented one.

max_input_tokens.description: Most tokens one input may hold; 0 takes the named model's documented window. Required for a model this build does not know; may only lower a documented one.

compacted_max_age_days.description: Age at which compacted summaries are dropped; 0 = never.

compaction_batch_size.description: Raw episodes pulled into one pass.

compaction_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two episodes into one cluster.

compaction_min_age_days.description: Only compact rows older than this.

consolidated_grace_days.description: Audit grace before a consolidated raw row is dropped.

exemplar_count.description: Originals kept raw after a cluster is compacted (at least 1).

max_raw_episodes_per_agent.description: Raw episodes per seat that trigger a lifecycle pass.

non_terminal_max_age_days.description: Age at which mid-state episodes are dropped.

tool_free_max_age_days.description: Age at which raw turns that called no tools are dropped.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The Expo account the agents' robot users act for. Required when enabled.

account_name.description: Expo account or organization name, as it appears in expo.dev/accounts/<name>, that the agents' robot users act for.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

token.description: Organization token with admin:org_hook, for one organization-wide hook. Empty means each agent's own app carries its own.

url.description: Enterprise Server base URL, e.g. https://github.example.com. Empty = github.com.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret for inbound deliveries; required when enabled.

org_webhook.description: auto (one org hook where the credential may), true, or false.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

signing_secret.description: Standard-Webhooks signing token; required when enabled.

token.description: Read PAT for participants-based routing; empty degrades routing.

webhook_name.description: Name every hook the engine registers on this instance carries; give two deployments watching one instance two names (default crewlet).

admin_token.description: Personal access token with the full api scope, belonging to a group owner. Creates and removes the service accounts.

group.description: Top-level group the service accounts join.

group_webhook.description: auto (one group hook if the plan allows), true, or false.

mode.description: Where service accounts are owned: group (default, and all GitLab.com offers) or instance (self-managed only; needs an instance-administrator token).

projects.description: Extra projects to join and hook.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The provisioner service account, the Workload Identity Federation provider and the engine's federation key the agents' service accounts are made with. Required when enabled.

federation_key.description: The engine's ES256 private key (PKCS#8 PEM) whose public half the federation provider holds. Minted by the connect form and never shown; it can act as the provisioner, which can create service accounts in the identity project and grant the agent levels.

provider.description: Full resource name of the Workload Identity Federation provider holding the engine's public key: projects/<number>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/<pool>/providers/<provider>. Until it is set, no agent's account can be made.

provisioner.description: Email of the provisioner service account, <id>@<identity project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com. The agents' service accounts are created in its project.

api_key.description: ${VAR} holding an API key, read under auth.mode api-key. Empty reads the harness's own key variable.

credential_bundle.description: ${VAR} holding a bundle exported by crewlet llm export.

mode.description: subscription (default), api-key, inherit-env, or env (the entry's env signs the harness in: a cloud provider or a gateway).

retention_days.description: How long a person's inbox keeps a notice (default 365, 30..3650). The history it points at is untouched.

accepted.description: The insights catalogue schema an administrator accepted. A newer catalogue shares nothing until it is accepted again.

always.description: Catalogue classes sent without waiting for review, in review mode.

share.description: off (the default), review (each record waits for an administrator to send it) or auto (every eligible record is sent).

atlassian.description: Atlassian organization and its unscoped API key, used to create one service account per agent. Absent = accounts are made by hand.

aws.description: The Crewlet stack in an AWS account and the engine's certificate authority, used to create one IAM role per agent through IAM Roles Anywhere. Absent = disabled.

check_interval_seconds.description: How often a converged integration is read back, in seconds. 0 takes the default of 600; the floor is 60.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare account and provisioner token, used to mint one account API token per agent. Absent = disabled.

confluence.description: Confluence instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

datadog.description: Datadog monitor alerts delivered as inbound events. Absent = disabled.

digitalocean.description: DigitalOcean team the agents' tokens act in: a person creates each agent's personal access token and pastes it. Absent = disabled.

expo.description: Expo account the agents' robot users act for: a person creates each agent's robot and pastes its token. Absent = disabled.

forge_app_id.description: Forge app id, verified against a relayed Cloud event's invocation token. Required for Jira or Confluence Cloud.

github.description: GitHub.com or Enterprise Server, webhook secret and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

gitlab.description: GitLab instance, webhook signing and provisioning. Absent = disabled.

google_cloud.description: Google Cloud provisioner service account and federation key, used to create one service account per agent and grant it on the projects prepared for Crewlet. Absent = disabled.

jira.description: Jira instance or Cloud site, org read account and webhook secret. Absent = disabled.

mattermost.description: Mattermost instance and team. Absent = disabled.

scaleway.description: Scaleway Organization and provisioner key, used to make one IAM application, policy and API key per agent. Absent = disabled.

slack.description: Slack working-indicator settings. Each seat carries its own app under role.integrations.slack. Absent = disabled.

ssh.description: The engine's SSH certificate authority and the servers agents may reach with short-lived certificates it signs. Absent = disabled.

enabled.description: Send anonymous reports of engine defects to the project's issue tracker. Each is a typed record: never a name, a message, a path, an address or anything else of the company's.

cloud_id.description: Atlassian Cloud id. Give this or url, not both.

email.description: Set for Cloud Basic auth; omit for bearer-token auth.

site_url.description: Human-readable base for shareable links; needed with cloud_id.

token.description: Admin API token or PAT; ${VAR} supported.

url.description: Instance URL. Give this or cloud_id, not both.

webhook_name.description: Name the engine's own Jira webhook is registered under; give two deployments watching one instance two names (default crewlet).

backend.description: Which knowledge base: doclet, confluence, or none. Empty derives from integrations.confluence.

root_space.description: Container for org-level pages such as the root Onboarding. Absent takes the default.

skills_container.description: Container holding tool-skill pages. Absent takes the default; "" turns tool skills off.

vectors.description: Fuse semantic recall into knowledge and work search; false also stops embedding the corpus. Unset derives from providers.embeddings.

env.description: Extra environment for the harness, on this host and in every executor run's box (beneath the seat's role.sandbox.env).

max_concurrent.description: Concurrent harness processes on this host; each costs 200-400 MB. Executor runs are not counted: each seat runs at most one.

model.description: Model id, in the harness's own grammar (OpenCode: <provider>/<model>).

overrides.description: Field-wise overrides of the built-in harness profile.

run_in.description: Where a seat's executor run on this entry happens. Empty = providers.sandbox.default_run_in.

state_dir.description: Credential + per-seat home directory, each harness under <state_dir>/<harness>. Entries sharing one and a harness share a login.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap on one stretch of a harness run on this host with no tool call in flight (default 600). Executor runs are not on this clock.

enabled.description: Master switch for agent learning (default on).

image.description: Container image: with the harness installed for an executor run's box, and git 2.40 or newer and what its checks build with for a check's. Required where an executor run or a check runs in a container.

network.description: Container network; setting it to none also cuts off the harness's LLM.

run_args.description: Extra container run arguments. This is where a local box is sized.

runtime_env.description: Environment for the container runtime's own CLI (not the box); ${VAR} supported.

state_dir.description: Parent directory for box directories; used by both local placements and by deep work on the engine host.

except.description: Agent seat handles left out although a unit in units holds them.

seats.description: Agent seat handles that get this server.

units.description: Unit keys whose agent seats get this server, the seats of every unit beneath each included.

enabled.description: false turns this server off for the seat, or for every agent seat beneath the unit; the grant and its values stay. A limit cannot turn a server on, so true is refused.

tools.description: One tool held to a stricter level, keyed by the server's own name for it: approve (each call waits for a person's answer) or blocked (never offered).

client.description: How the engine registers at the authorization server for a person's sign-in (grant authorization_code): cimd (its published client metadata document), dcr (registers when a sign-in starts) or own (a client registered at the vendor beforehand).

client_id.description: The client id of the company's own client (client: own, or grant: client_credentials).

client_secret.description: The secret of the company's own client: required for grant client_credentials, and for client own where the client has one; ${VAR} supported.

grant.description: How the engine is granted access: authorization_code (default: a person signs the company in once) or client_credentials (a service identity: the company's own client, with client_id and client_secret, and no person).

scopes.description: Scopes the sign-in asks for; absent, a person's sign-in asks for the ones the server lists and a service identity for its client's default.

url.description: The registry's https address; /v0.1/servers is appended to it. Absent: no community search.

access.description: Which agent seats get this server: units (every agent seat beneath each), seats, and except. Absent = every agent seat. Not for a server bound to a vendor's per-seat credential, which the integration grants.

description.description: What this server is for, one line of at most 200 characters; listed beside its name in each agent's prompt.

enabled.description: Run this server (default on). Off keeps the entry and everything that names it, and starts nothing.

headers.description: Headers sent with each request (http); ${VAR} supported.

name.description: Server name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 32 characters; the key seats declare credentials under.

oauth.description: Sign the company in to this remote server with OAuth (http, shared): the grant (a person's sign-in, or a service identity's client credentials), how the engine registers, and the scopes it asks for.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env, headers or a seat's mcp_env block for this server whose value may resolve to nothing; such a key is left out rather than holding the server back.

seat_credentials.description: Per-seat credentials this server reads: integration, field, and the variable or header it reads each under. Absent for a server the engine recognises.

shared.description: One shared instance (default), or false for one per seat.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Bounds connect and handshake, and separately the first tool listing. 0 is the engine's default.

tool_annotations.description: Per-tool behavioural-hint overrides, keyed by bare tool name.

tool_prefix.description: Prefix put in front of every tool this server serves: letters, digits, _ and -, at most 49 characters.

tools.description: The level each tool runs at: default for every tool, levels for one tool by the server's own name. allow offers it; blocked never offers it to an agent. Absent = every tool allowed.

default.description: The level of every tool levels does not name: allow, approve or blocked. Unset, a tool the server marks read-only runs at allow and every other tool at approve.

levels.description: One tool's level, keyed by the server's own name for the tool (before tool_prefix): allow, approve or blocked.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: Inputs the reconcile loop and the provisioning CLI both read.

team.description: Team slug the agent bots belong to.

typing_status.description: When to show the typing indicator (default always); it costs a request every few seconds per thinking seat.

admin_token.description: System-admin token used to create and to disable the bots.

display_name_suffix.description: Suffix on each bot display name, e.g. " (AI)".

username_prefix.description: Prefix on each bot username, e.g. agent-.

max_refreshes_per_turn.description: Distinct memory refreshes one turn may make.

embeddings.description: Embedding provider for semantic knowledge search and for diary and episode recall.

llm.description: Named models, each a harness the engine drives; seats select one by key.

llm_order.description: Provider precedence; normally derived from the order they are written in.

sandbox.description: Where every agent seat's executor runs. Required once the company has an agent seat and a providers.llm entry.

enabled.description: Run reflection after each turn (default on).

persist_decider.description: Run the persist decision after each turn (default on).

summarize_episodes.description: Summarise the turn-start Similar prior work block's hits into one briefing through the auxiliary model (default on); query_episodes is never summarised.

availability.description: Human seats: free-text availability shown in rosters.

avatar.description: Agent seats: the Crewlet character and colour the seat is drawn as. Absent = the original Crewlet, in purple.

backstory.description: Who this seat is; reaches its prompt.

behavioral_guidelines.description: How this seat should work; reaches its prompt.

code.description: This seat's access to the company's code on Gitlet, the engine's own git host (code.backend: gitlet).

contact.description: Human seats: external account ids per surface.

email.description: Seat email; plus-addressing derives from the handle.

goal.description: What this seat is for; reaches its prompt.

handle.description: Canonical slug, and how lead and manages name this seat. Immutable: it derives the seat's durable id, so changing it removes the seat and creates another.

health_tools.description: Agent seats: offer this seat fleet_health and code_status, the administrator's reads of the deployment's health, and wake it each time an alarm fires or clears on a node. Setting or clearing it takes admin.

learning_enabled.description: Override company learning for this seat.

llm.description: Provider key, chain, or per-phase mapping.

llm_auxiliary.description: Cheap model for reflection and summaries.

llm_judge.description: Cheap model for the round-cap extension judge.

manages.description: Seat handles or unit keys this seat manages; a unit key expands to its seats.

mcp_env.description: Per-seat MCP credentials: env vars (stdio) or headers (http).

mcp_limits.description: Narrow the MCP servers this agent seat is granted, keyed by server name: off turns one off for the seat, tools holds a tool at approve or blocked. Never widens: the strictest of this, every enclosing unit's and the server's own entry applies.

name.description: Seat name, shown to people; also the source of the auto-derived handle. Nothing references a seat by it.

placement.description: Which nodes may run this seat. Absent = any node that runs seats.

project.description: Tracker project this seat owns. Root-level seats; a unit member takes its unit's.

sandbox.description: What this seat's executor box reads beyond providers.sandbox: setup, env, optional_keys, mcp, pause_ttl_seconds, max_turns. Absent = the engine-wide settings only.

schedules.description: Recurring work fired into this seat's inbox.

space.description: Knowledge container this seat owns. Root-level seats; a unit member takes its unit's.

token_budget.description: This seat's own token ceilings per calendar window on the company clock: day, week and month, each optional. Absent = only the company's ceilings apply.

unit.description: Key (id) of the home unit for a root-level seat; the seat is moved into it.

workers.description: Delegate templates this seat may use; empty = every one.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own IAM role. Off attaches AWS's deny-all policy and detaches its levels; the role and its CloudTrail history stay.

level.description: read (the default): describe and list compute, networking, containers, functions, databases, DNS and CDN, read metrics and CloudWatch Logs, and list object names, with no object, parameter or secret contents. operate: read plus starting, stopping, rebooting and scaling, invoking functions, invalidating the CDN, editing alarms and reading and writing S3 objects. administer: operate plus managing those services whole, which can leave access behind such as key pairs, user data and bucket policies.

character.description: The Crewlet character this agent seat is drawn as. Absent = crewlet, the original.

color.description: The colour this agent seat is drawn in. Absent = purple.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own Cloudflare token. Off deletes the token.

level.description: read (the default): zone, DNS, cache, firewall and WAF rule, IP list, SSL and analytics reads. operate: read plus cache purge and cache rule edits. configure: operate plus compression rule edits and every zone setting, the SSL mode and security level included. secure: configure plus WAF rule and IP list edits.

access.description: read_only, review or full_access on Gitlet. Empty means read_only.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has Confluence access. Off removes its space access and its token's Confluence scopes, and keeps the account.

operations.description: Confluence space permissions as operation:target, where the site has no space roles.

space_role.description: Confluence space role id, where the site has role-based access; with operations also empty, product access only.

spaces.description: Confluence space keys this agent holds the role in.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has a Datadog service account. Off disables the account and keeps it.

role.description: Datadog role id (GET /api/v2/roles), managed or custom.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own DigitalOcean personal access token, which a person creates in the control panel and pastes. Off revokes the token at DigitalOcean and clears its sealed copy.

level.description: The token's DigitalOcean scopes. read (the default): reads Droplets, volumes, networking, DNS, databases, Kubernetes, apps and monitoring. operate: read plus creating, changing and deleting them. administer: operate plus cluster credentials, database passwords and consoles, which can outlive the token.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own Expo robot user, which a person creates at Expo and pastes the token of. Off clears its sealed token.

level.description: The robot's Expo role. viewer (the default): views all projects. runner: views projects and performs low-risk actions on them. developer: creates builds, publishes updates to unprotected channels and manages credentials. release_manager: developer plus protected channels.

app_id.description: Numeric id of this seat's GitHub App. Written by the engine.

app_slug.description: Slug of this seat's GitHub App; the bot login derives from it.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own GitHub App. Off suspends the installation and keeps the app.

installation_id.description: Installation of this seat's app on the organization. Written by the engine.

permissions.description: GitHub App permissions (contents, issues, pull_requests, checks, actions, deployments, workflows), each read or write; absent is No access.

private_key.description: Reference to this seat's sealed GitHub App key. Returned by GitHub once.

repos.description: Repositories this seat works in, as owner/name. Empty means all the installation covers.

webhook_secret.description: Reference to this seat's sealed GitHub App webhook secret. Returned by GitHub once.

access_level.description: GitLab role: 10 Guest, 15 Planner, 20 Reporter, 30 Developer, 40 Maintainer, 50 Owner.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has a GitLab service account. Off blocks the account and keeps it.

member_role_id.description: GitLab custom role id (Ultimate), instead of access_level.

projects.description: Projects this agent is a member of; empty means the whole group.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own Google Cloud service account. Off disables it and removes its roles; the account and its audit history stay.

level.description: viewer (the default): read the project, Compute, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, DNS, buckets, metrics and logs, and call Google's MCP tools. operator: viewer plus restarting and scaling VMs, pods and Cloud SQL, running Cloud Run jobs, editing alerting and reading and writing Cloud Storage objects. administer: operator plus managing VMs, networks, firewalls, clusters, Cloud SQL, DNS and buckets, which can leave access behind; granting it needs a fresh sign-in.

projects.description: Google Cloud project IDs this agent's level is granted on, each prepared for Crewlet. Required when enabled: an agent in no project can reach nothing.

aws.description: This seat's own IAM role: whether it is on and its level.

cloudflare.description: This seat's own Cloudflare account API token: whether it is on and its level.

confluence.description: This seat's Confluence access: whether it is on, its space role and its spaces.

datadog.description: This seat's Datadog service account: whether it is on and its role.

digitalocean.description: This seat's own DigitalOcean personal access token: whether it is on and its level.

expo.description: This seat's own Expo robot user: whether it is on and its level.

github.description: This seat's own GitHub App: whether it is on, its permissions, and where.

gitlab.description: This seat's GitLab service account: whether it is on, its role and its projects.

google_cloud.description: This seat's own Google Cloud service account: whether it is on, its level and its projects.

jira.description: This seat's Jira access: whether it is on, its project role and its projects.

mattermost.description: This seat's Mattermost bot: whether it is on, its roles and its channels.

scaleway.description: This seat's own Scaleway IAM application: whether it is on, its level and its projects.

slack.description: This seat's own Slack app: whether it is on.

ssh.description: This seat's SSH access: whether it is on, its level and its servers.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has Jira access. Off removes its project roles and its token's Jira scopes, and keeps the account.

project_role.description: Jira project role id (GET /rest/api/3/role); empty is product access only.

projects.description: Jira project keys this agent holds the role in.

bot_token.description: Bot personal access token; one credential covers everything.

channels.description: Channels this agent's bot is a member of.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has a Mattermost bot. Off revokes its tokens and deactivates it.

roles.description: Mattermost roles: system_user, plus system_post_all_public or system_post_all, or system_admin.

username.description: Bot username, or one whole ${VAR} naming it; defaults to the seat handle.

labels.description: Node labels that must all match.

node.description: Exact node id to pin this seat to.

enabled.description: Whether this agent may reach servers over SSH. Off stops issuing its certificates at once; ones already issued expire within minutes.

hosts.description: Ids of the servers in integrations.ssh.hosts this agent may reach. Required when the agent is on.

level.description: read (the default): the server's allowlisted read commands, with no approval. operate: read, plus any command, each one approved by a person before it runs.

env.description: Env for this seat's executor run; declare external tokens here.

max_turns.description: Agentic-round cap for one of this seat's executor runs. Unset = providers.sandbox.default_max_turns; 0 = uncapped.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env whose value may resolve to nothing; such a key is left out quietly rather than logged as a gap in the run's environment.

pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL. Unset = provider default; 0 = never pause.

setup.description: Per-seat provisioning steps, applied after the engine-wide ones.

servers.description: MCP servers that run in this seat's executor box; its tool bridge serves every other.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own Scaleway IAM application, policy and API key. Off deletes all three.

level.description: read (the default): servers, storage, networks, DNS and databases in its projects, plus the audit trail. operate: read plus restarting servers and changing firewalls, IPs, load balancers and private networks. administer: operate plus creating and changing servers, disks, databases, Kubernetes and the registry, which can leave access behind; granting it needs a fresh sign-in.

projects.description: Scaleway project IDs this agent's policy grants its level on. Required when enabled: an agent in no project can reach nothing.

bot_token.description: Bot token for outbound Web API calls.

enabled.description: Whether this agent has its own Slack app. Off revokes the bot token and keeps the app.

signing_secret.description: Verifies inbound webhooks for this seat's app.

approvers.description: Handles of human seats that may approve an agent's operate command, beside administrators. Optional.

commands.description: How long a command may run and how much of its output reaches the agent. Optional.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

hosts.description: The servers agents may be granted, at most 200, each with its address, pinned host keys and the two login users the server setup creates.

provisioning.description: The engine's SSH certificate authority, a staged next one during a rotation, and the addresses certificates may be used from. Required when enabled.

max_output_bytes.description: Bytes of each of a command's output streams returned to the agent, the rest cut: 4096 to 1048576. Empty is 65536.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds a command may run before the engine stops it: 10 to 900. Empty is 120.

address.description: The server's host name or IP address, with no scheme, user, port or path.

containers.description: Let the read user list containers and read their logs through sudo -n docker ps and docker logs --tail. Off by default.

description.description: What the server is, in one line of up to 200 characters, shown to agents and approvers.

host_keys.description: The server's public host keys, one to eight lines as /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub holds them. The engine accepts no other key from this server and never learns one on first use.

id.description: Short name of the server: up to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It is part of every certificate principal for this server, so changing it means running the server setup again.

port.description: The server's SSH port. Empty is 22.

read_allowlist.description: The commands the read user may run, one rule each, replacing the default list: an absolute path, then words, where * is any one word not starting with -, a word ending in =* is that option with any value, and a final ... is any further words. At most 100 rules. Empty renders the default list.

users.description: The login users the server setup creates.

operate.description: The login user for approved operate commands, such as crewlet-ops. Absent leaves the server read-only.

read.description: The login user for read access, whose every command is forced through the server's read allowlist, such as crewlet-read.

certificate_authority.description: Reference to the engine's SSH certificate authority, an unencrypted OpenSSH Ed25519 private key such as ${SSH_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY}. Minted by the connect form and never shown; servers trust only its public line. It can sign a certificate for any host's read or operate user.

next_certificate_authority.description: Reference to a staged certificate authority, such as ${SSH_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY_NEXT}, present only while a rotation is in progress. The engine never signs with it until it is promoted.

source_addresses.description: Address ranges, such as 203.0.113.7/32, every certificate may be used from: the engine's egress addresses. At most 16. Empty leaves certificates usable from anywhere until they expire.

commit_attribution.description: Credit Crewlet on every commit an executor authors as itself: Co-authored-by: Crewlet <noreply@crewlet.ai>, Crewlet-Seat naming the seat, Crewlet-Run naming the run, and Crewlet-Work-Item naming the item its turn is charged to. Unset = true; false = credit nothing.

default_max_turns.description: Agentic-round cap for one executor run on seats that name none. Unset or 0 = uncapped.

default_pause_ttl_seconds.description: Paused-box TTL before reap and re-seed. Unset = 1800s; 0 = never pause.

default_run_in.description: Where a run launched on a providers.llm entry with no run_in happens. Required unless the catalogue names exactly one cell, or every entry a seat's executor can launch on names its own.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Box TTL/keepalive. Not a run cap: the orphan-reclaim grace.

e2b.description: The remote backend. Absent = run_in: e2b is refused.

fake.description: Use the in-process double for every placement. Demonstrations only.

local.description: The engine host as a backend. Absent = run_in: direct|container is refused.

setup.description: Provisioning steps applied to every box before per-seat extras.

brief.description: What this step made true about the box, told to the harness.

commands.description: Shell commands run in order; a non-zero exit fails the box.

env.description: Env merged into the run; resolved once at launch, not at load.

files.description: Files written into the box before commands run; a body that is exactly one ${VAR} is that variable's value.

name.description: Short identifier used in logs and failure messages.

optional_keys.description: Keys of env, or paths of files, whose value may resolve to nothing; left out quietly rather than logged as a gap in the run's environment.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-command wall-clock cap for this step.

enabled.description: Turn the integration on.

provisioning.description: The Scaleway Organization and the provisioner key the engine makes each agent's IAM application, policy and API key with. Required when enabled.

access_key.description: Access key of the provisioner application's API key: SCW followed by 17 capital letters or digits.

organization_id.description: Scaleway Organization ID (a UUID) the agents' IAM applications are created in.

secret_key.description: Secret key of the provisioner API key, whose application holds IAMApplicationManager, IAMPolicyManager and ProjectReadOnly on the Organization. It can mint keys for, and grant anything to, any application in the Organization: give it a short expiry and rotate it.

catchup_max_seconds.description: Upper clamp on the missed-tick catchup window.

catchup_min_seconds.description: Lower clamp on the missed-tick catchup window (at least 1).

enabled.description: Master switch for the scheduler (default on).

jitter_seconds.description: Deterministic per-schedule jitter to spread a popular minute.

tick_seconds.description: Scheduler poll interval; under 60s catches every cron minute.

work_pickup.description: Hands an idle agent seat its next ready work item (default on).

as.description: env (stdio) or header (http); defaults to the transport's.

field.description: Which seat credential (Atlassian: TOKEN or EMAIL). Empty means the integration's credential.

key.description: Environment variable (stdio) or header (http) the server reads it under.

kind.description: Integration whose per-seat credential this server reads.

archive_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill is archived.

enabled.description: Age unused skills out (default on).

interval_hours.description: How often the curator walks the skill table.

stale_after_days.description: Unused days before a skill goes stale.

enabled.description: Promote sibling skills to unit scope (default on).

jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two seats' skills.

min_sibling_count.description: Distinct seats a cluster needs before promotion.

auto_refine_on_failure.description: Append a counter-example when it failed (default on).

auto_refine_on_success.description: Append an observation when a skill's turn succeeded (default on).

enabled.description: Refine skills after use (default on).

max_body_chars.description: Ceiling on a refined skill's body.

cluster_jaccard_threshold.description: Similarity that pools two turns into one cluster.

cluster_min_size.description: Turns a cluster needs before it earns a skill.

cluster_window_hours.description: How far back the clustering pass looks.

duplicate_jaccard_threshold.description: Reject a draft this similar to an existing skill.

enabled.description: Draft skills from turns (default on).

episode_fetch_limit.description: Episodes pulled into one clustering pass.

min_tool_calls.description: Tool calls a turn needs before an inline draft.

scheduler_interval_seconds.description: How often the clustering pass runs.

app_config_token.description: Reference to the sealed Slack app-configuration token the engine creates agents' apps with; a whole ${VAR}.

typing_status.description: When to show the working indicator (default always).

default.description: Lines for any phase with no pool of its own.

execute.description: Lines shown while the agent works.

onboarding.description: Lines shown during the first-turn onboarding pass.

review.description: Lines shown while the reviewer judges the work.

day.description: Most tokens one day may spend, local midnight to midnight on the company clock. Absent = no daily ceiling; 0 is refused.

month.description: Most tokens one calendar month (on the company clock) may spend. Absent = no monthly ceiling; 0 is refused.

week.description: Most tokens one ISO week (from Monday, on the company clock) may spend. Absent = no weekly ceiling; 0 is refused.

backend.description: Which work tracker: worklet, jira, or none. Empty derives from integrations.jira.

delegation_depth_limit.description: Maximum depth of agent-to-agent delegation chains.

executor_min_budget_tokens.description: Refuse an executor launch, and park the seat, below this remaining token budget (default 25000; 0 = no floor).

extension_enabled.description: Round-cap extension judge for the onboarding pass (default on).

extension_round_step.description: Maximum onboarding rounds one extension call may grant.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds.description: Rounds for the first-turn onboarding pass (default 10); 0 disables it.

onboarding_max_tool_rounds_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling for onboarding rounds across extensions.

channel.description: Unit channel on the company's chat surface, e.g. engineering; inherited by child units. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

goals.description: What this unit is working toward.

id.description: Stable identity for this unit, and how lead, manages and unit references key it. Minted from the name at import when unset. Lowercase, starts with a letter.

knowledge.description: Free-text knowledge references. Not a read scope.

lead.description: Handle of the seat leading this unit; inherited from the parent when empty.

mcp_env.description: Credentials inherited by this unit's direct agent members.

mcp_limits.description: Narrow the MCP servers granted to every agent seat beneath this unit, at any depth, keyed by server name: off turns one off for them, tools holds a tool at approve or blocked. Never widens: the strictest of this, every enclosing unit's, the seat's own and the server's entry applies.

name.description: Unit name, shown to people. Nothing references a unit by it.

project.description: Tracker project this unit owns. Not a credential, not a read scope.

schedules.description: Recurring work owned by this unit.

space.description: Knowledge container this unit owns. Not a credential, not a read scope.

cooldown_seconds.description: Least time between two pickups of one seat, 60..1800 seconds (default 600).

enabled.description: Hand an idle agent seat its next ready work item (default on).

description.description: What this worker is for, written for the executor choosing one.

max_turns.description: Tool rounds this worker may run; 0 takes the runtime cap.

model.description: providers.llm key for this worker; empty takes the seat's llm_subagent chain.

output.description: JSON Schema for this worker's structured answer. Absent takes the default shape.

system_prompt.description: The worker's persona and standing instructions. The runtime preamble is appended.

tools.description: Tools this worker asks for. Still filtered against the caller's own tools at spawn.

mcp_registry.description: The community MCP registry the dashboard searches beside the curated catalogue. Absent: none.

mcp_servers.description: Tool servers, stdio or http. Per-agent credentials live in role.mcp_env.

mission.description: One line on what the company is for; reaches every seat's prompt.

name.description: Company name. Half of every seat's derived id: effectively permanent.

notification_coalesce_max_batch.description: Events drained into one batch before partitioning by conversation, 1..100. Bounds a digest too, since a digest cannot exceed a drain.

notification_coalesce_window_seconds.description: Inbox linger before dispatch, 0..60s. 0 adds no latency.

notification_rate_limit.description: Inbound notifications one seat may be woken by per second; 0 (default) = unlimited.

policies.description: Company-wide rules injected into every seat's prompt.

seat_access_migrated.description: Integrations whose agent seats state their access per seat. Written by the engine's migration.

skill_variables.description: name -> value facts substituted into tool-skill text. Keys must be identifiers.

timezone.description: The company's one clock, an IANA zone (default UTC): where its days and weeks begin, what a relative or all-day date resolves to, and what a schedule naming no zone fires on.

token_budget.description: Org-wide token ceilings across all seats, per calendar window on the company clock: day, week and month, each optional. Absent = uncapped.

units.description: The org hierarchy; units nest to any depth.

vision.description: Longer statement of where the company is going.

workers.description: Reusable delegate templates, keyed by the name an executor calls them by.
